544:t_1:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Briefing Room～

544:t_1:5.en:
$$オルソン$$
「It seems this past week shocked you in your own way.」

544:t_1:7.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Since the $$大時空震動$$, various organizations pursued us as Singularities. We held a literally unique position in this multiverse...」

544:t_1:8.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Having that completely denied was almost like having our own existence denied.」

544:t_1:9.en:
$$桂$$
「But at the same time, I realized I'd been putting too much pressure on myself.」

544:t_1:10.en:
$$オルソン$$
「You were putting pressure on yourself?」

544:t_1:11.en:
$$桂$$
「It's just like you said. Being a $$特異点$$ made me think I was something special.」

544:t_1:12.en:
$$桂$$
「Basically, I was the one treating myself as special.」

544:t_1:13.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm just $$桂木桂$$... $c's ace pilot and the handsome man of the century.」

544:t_1:14.en:
$$オルソン$$
「You're still carrying quite a lot there.」

544:t_1:15.en:
$$桂$$
「What about you, $$オルソン$$? Weren't you shocked?」

544:t_1:16.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Unlike you, I know my own limits. Besides...」

544:t_1:18.en:
$$オルソン$$
「When $$サイデリアル$$ held me captive, a researcher said this about the Singularities...」

544:t_1:20.en:
$$桂$$
「Three...? You mean there's one more $$特異点$$ besides you and me?」

544:t_1:21.en:
$$オルソン$$
「That is how we should interpret it.」

544:t_1:22.en:
$$桂$$
「Then if we find that third person, we'll manage even if space-time is about to collapse?」

544:t_1:24.en:
$$桂$$
「Okay. Then I have someone in mind.」

544:t_1:26.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm sure that third person is the captive princess we're pursuing right now.」

544:t_1:28.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah, that's right. There's something... a little unusual about her.」

544:t_1:29.en:
$$オルソン$$
「So that is why $$アマルガム$$ targeted her...」

544:t_1:33.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

544:t_1:34.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...I really owe $$キリコ$$ one...」

544:t_1:36.en:
$$クルツ$$
「If I trace it back, maybe I should thank you and $$カナメ$$ too.」

544:t_1:37.en:
$$宗介$$
「It seems a virus has infected your brain.」

544:t_1:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「Go to Lieutenant $$カナリア$$ at once. If it is contagious, you will endanger the entire unit.」

544:t_1:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「You have a confession...? If I will do, I shall hear it.」

544:t_1:42.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Listen. What I'm about to tell you stays between us.」

544:t_1:44.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Well... uh... actually, I... We got talking about $$キリコ$$ and $$フィアナ$$, and things heated up...」

544:t_1:47.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Huh... Why does it matter...? Well... It's bad, right?」

544:t_1:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「You mean the two of you fell asleep while on duty?」

544:t_1:49.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Come on! We're a man and a woman! There's only one thing that could mean!」

544:t_1:52.en:
$$シェリル$$
「A-aha... I'm jealous of how close you are.」

544:t_1:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
「T-talking about things like that in a place like this is how discipline begins to break down!」

544:t_1:56.en:
$$テッサ$$
「A-as punishment, Master Sergeant $$ウェーバー$$, I order you to receive an operation briefing from Ensign $$マオ$$ until we deploy!」

544:t_1:62.en:
$$シェリル$$
「He really is a sniper... He never lets his prey escape.」

544:t_1:64.en:
$$シェリル$$
「See you, Captain $$テッサ$$. We're on meal duty.」

544:t_1:65.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Please do your best... in the next operation.」

544:t_1:66.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Thank you for showing me around, $$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$.」

544:t_1:67.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Um... Captain... Earlier... $$クルツ$$ was... well... I apologize for his rudeness.」

544:t_1:68.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Please don't worry. ...It did surprise me a little, though.」

544:t_1:69.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But I didn't expect that. You talk about those things too, $$相良$$.」

544:t_1:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is not it. $$クルツ$$ just started...」

544:t_1:71.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Hee hee... It's been a while since I saw you flustered, $$相良$$.」

544:t_1:73.en:
$$テッサ$$
「At $$ヤムスク１１$$, where we are heading, I will need you to guard me. I came to discuss that.」

544:t_1:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then I would have come to see you, Captain...」

544:t_1:75.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It's all right... I wanted... a small change of scenery...」

544:t_1:76.en:
$$宗介$$
(I have heard that the next operation is important to our strategy against $$アマルガム$$...)

544:t_1:77.en:
$$宗介$$
(The Captain bears that pressure... all by herself...)

544:t_1:79.en:
$$宗介$$
「Nothing... I swear I will protect you with all my strength, Captain.」

544:t_1:80.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you. I'm glad I came to the hangar.」

544:t_1:81.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Let me be selfish about one more thing. May I stay here and watch you work, $$相良$$?」

544:t_1:83.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We can actually do that later. We must cross Imperial territory to reach our destination, so let's think about getting there first.」

544:t_1:85.en:
$$宗介$$
「I understand, $$テッサ$$. Watch for as long as you like.」
